IncidentBot: URGENT: paging SRE_Oncall_Jamie - GPU pool "pool-prod-1" at 96% GPU util, queue length 1,150, average latency 3.2s. Autoscaler attempted scale -> hit max_nodes=12. Detected spike in request token length and KV-cache miss rate.
SRE_Oncall_Jamie: ack - I'm on it. Pls post any customer-facing alerts. @Infra_Sam can you pull autoscaler logs?
Infra_Sam: looking now. seeing repeated "scale up failed: quota_exceeded" from cloud provider at 19:12 UTC. Also K8s pods stuck in Pending due to GPU allocation. Queue is growing fast.
Eng_Runtime_Maya: heads up — there was a model rollout ~19:00 (model-v7.2) that changed tokenizer/context padding. Early telemetry showed ~+30% tokens per request for some routes. DeployBot can confirm.
DeployBot: pipeline: model-v7.2 promoted at 19:01 UTC by ci/cd. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/model-registry/pull/842. Rollout target intended 20% but traffic routing config drifted to 60%.
SRE_Oncall_Jamie: that matches the spike. Quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle new model traffic to 10% 2) fallback to v7.1 for non-critical routes 3) raise autoscaler max temporarily 4) alert CS and Support.
Infra_Sam: I can bump max_nodes to 18 but cloud quota approval needed (~5-10m). Doing now: `gcloud compute resource-quotas increase --project=redwood-prod --resource=accelerator.nvidia-a100:8 --zone=us-west1-b`
Infra_Sam: also reclaiming GPUs by draining low-priority workloads. Executing:
```
kubectl patch hpa gpu-autoscaler -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":18}}'
kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep Pending
```
Eng_Runtime_Maya: adding temporary short TTL for KV-cache to force warmup: set `kv_cache.ttl_seconds=60` for v7.2 instances. This will increase I/O but reduces cold-miss spike after warmups.
Support_Anya: Customer impact: CS dashboard shows ~12 customers with elevated latency; 2 customers (acme-co, betaapp) reporting 502s on embed endpoints. Notifying affected customers now.
Product_CS_Leo: please prepare a short customer note: we are mitigating, expect temporary rate limits and improved ETA within 30m.
Support_Anya: message sent to affected customers. Included rollback window and ETA. No data loss reported.
SRE_Oncall_Jamie: applying temporary traffic reroute, reducing model-v7.2 rollout weight to 10%:
```
# traffic control command
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/traffic -d '{"model":"model-v7.2","weight":0.10}'
```
DeployBot: traffic change applied at 19:25 UTC, confirmed.
Infra_Sam: quota increase provisioned and nodes are booting, new GPU nodes healthy at 19:31 UTC. Autoscaler started adding nodes, queue dropping from ~1100 -> 120 in ~6m.
SRE_Oncall_Jamie: keeping throttles in place. We'll keep v7.2 at 10% while monitoring KV warmups and token throughput. Please collect GPU mem, eviction, and KV hit-rate for postmortem.
Eng_Runtime_Maya: action item - add runway tests to CI for token-length regressions and enforce rollout-weight guard. Also want an automated check that disallows >15% median tokens/request increase during canary.
Product_CS_Leo: Customer update: most customers report latency improved after 19:35. One customer needed client-side retry tuning — CS reached out directly.
Support_Anya: summary for ops channel: root cause appears to be model-v7.2 increasing token footprint and cache warmup pattern causing a cold-miss storm; autoscaler hit max_nodes and failed to scale due to cloud quota. Mitigations: reduced rollout weight, temporary autoscaler max bump, KV TTL tuning, reclaimed GPUs, and customer notifications.
SRE_Oncall_Jamie: downgrade severity P1 -> P2 at 19:45 UTC. Creating postmortem ticket. Action items: (1) rollout-weight enforcement in CI (owner: Eng_Runtime_Maya) (2) autoscaler should emit clear alert when scale fails due to quota (owner: Infra_Sam) (3) model gating test for token-length regression (owner: Eng_ML) (4) add pre-rollout KV warmup benchmark (owner: Eng_Runtime_Maya).
Eng_Runtime_Maya: opening infra PR for token-length gating and CI rollout guard: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/291
IncidentBot: Incident paging disabled at 19:50 UTC. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
